reason: Verify every affected active backend contract has been considered and updated only to actual behavior.
Audit limits, retries, cancellation and recovery against concrete failure models and deterministic evidence.
Check end-to-end identity, route, authorization generation, error and secret flow across every layer.
Detect duplicate codecs, registries, validators, stores, session services or infrastructure profiles.
Check platform cfg completeness, hosted matrix evidence and source checkout contracts.
Confirm both ALPNs retain exact production/default and isolated self-hosted Relay contracts with no staging or map mixing.
Verify bounds, numeric kind uniqueness, compatibility, validated conversions and stable error codes.
Verify identity secrecy, SQLite v1 inventory, FULL persistence, checked generations and sole StoreActor ownership.
Verify same-UID admission precedes decode, strict unary semantics remain, and local readiness/inspection stay network-passive.
Verify principal detach and revoke preserve controller, replay, session and shutdown invariants.
Confirm no connection, stream, pairing or revoke path can close or signal a PTY.
Confirm PTY drain and host-authoritative terminal state remain independent of network backpressure and path loss.
Check implementation scope against the exact pre-task M4 boundary and M7/M8 exclusions.
Check pinned API use, fresh lookup ordering, dynamic route behavior, path observation and endpoint shutdown.
Check ticket vectors, one-time CAS, one-way authorization, permit lifetime and revoke ordering.
Check per-device connection reuse and independent bounded streams without global head-of-line queues.
Check current and future access is cut only after durable revoke while sessions remain live.
Check the product does not claim per-session or low-trust isolation that the OS-user shell cannot provide.
